properties.comment: The power is out to allow crews to safely balance load and perform maintenance. If you did not receive notification of this outage, please update your contact information. Power should be restored by noon. Thank you for your patience.
A crew is assigned and is working to troubleshoot the cause of this outage. Thank you for your patience.
